items.description: Implement the deterministic Tron engine: simultaneous movement, trails, collisions, draws, best-of-five scoring, turn queue, delayed-frame cap.
items.verify: Engine tests cover every rule in the brief and pass.

items.description: Implement easy, normal and hard opponents as seedable pure functions.
items.verify: AI tests prove no-suicide, larger-pocket choice, territory preference, seeded determinism, terminating AI-vs-AI match and a per-decision time bound.

items.description: Implement the paper-styled curses UI, controls for one and two players, and audio mapping.
items.verify: UI tests cover bindings, palette fallback, layout at 80x30 and 100x35, monochrome distinction, cues, mute and cleanup.

items.description: Verify real terminal input, pause, restart, resize, mute and clean exit.
items.verify: Real PTY with state assertions, Q and SIGINT exits, mode restoration and no surviving child group; retain transcript.

items.description: Provide documented launch and CLI options, and a menu cabinet.
items.verify: Help works without a terminal and lists every flag.

items.description: Existing games and menu are unchanged and still pass.
items.verify: Full local check passes, including the menu check that launches every game.

items.description: A human plays at least one full match on each level and in two-player mode and records how it feels.
items.verify: Mark only with the player's actual observation; if nobody played, leave unmarked and say so.

items.description: A human listens to the cues for turn, round win, crash, pause and mute.
items.verify: Mark only with who listened, the output device and what they heard; do not invent a listener.
